root.label: Ecuador intercepts Ola Bini and revokes visa

events.label: Ecuador intercepts Ola Bini and revokes visa

slots.name: visa status
slots.sentence: Bini, who has lived in Ecuador since 2013, was intercepted by immigration officers in northern Quito around midday Thursday and taken to immigration offices after authorities told him his visa had been revoked, according to court records reviewed by Ecuadorian news outlet Primicias.

slots.name: deportation status
slots.sentence: Bini and his lawyer, Carlos Soria, said authorities ordered his deportation before a judge ruled on the petition.

slots.name: reentry ban duration
slots.sentence: The deportation order prohibits Bini from returning to Ecuador for 10 years, according to Soria.
